description: Voigtländer于1958年推出的旁轴相机。配备Color-Skopar 50mm f/2.8 (4 elements in 3 groups).。快门速度Prontor SLK-V shutter (B, 1-300 sec) + built-in 8 second self-timer. Late cameras have a top speed of 500.。Manual with Rangefinder. Distance scale with zone focusing symbols.。

specs.取景器: Brilliant finder shows image at about 1:1. Superimposed Rangefinder
specs.对焦: Manual with Rangefinder. Distance scale with zone focusing symbols.
specs.快门: Prontor SLK-V shutter (B, 1-300 sec) + built-in 8 second self-timer. Late cameras have a top speed of 500.
specs.曝光测光: Manual match needle in top-plate window
specs.英文简介: The Vitomatic II is a camera made by Voigtländer from the first generation of 35mm Vitomatic.
